decisions.decision: Conflict rule is REPLACE - latest capture of a calendar day wins (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE)
decisions.why: A re-run normally corrects a bad/partial nightly capture, so freshest data should survive

decisions.decision: captured_date DATE column computed in Go from the poller's *time.Location; UNIQUE (account_id, tesla_id, captured_date)
decisions.why: A UNIQUE index cannot depend on the runtime POLLER_TIMEZONE env var; expression indexes on UTC or a hardcoded zone were rejected

decisions.decision: Backfill dedupe keeps the latest captured_at; the older row of each pair is deleted
decisions.why: Consistent with D1 so historical and future rows share one semantic. 2 rows deleted (verified live).

decisions.decision: Scope is vehicle_snapshots only; poll_attempts stays append-only
decisions.why: poll_attempts records every attempt including failures/retries - the availability signal a daily collapse would destroy

decisions.decision: Reverse the append-only invariant (supersedes RM1 design D1), document the supersession, and add updated_at
decisions.why: The original rationale for omitting updated_at (never overwritten) no longer holds once rows can be replaced

decisions.decision: Database design gate CONFIRMED - schema, rationale and index plan approved as specified in design.md
decisions.why: Blocking gate per CLAUDE.md Design-Gates: database. Backfill timezone literal verified immaterial (0/44 rows differ between UTC and America/Bogota).

decisions.decision: Pipeline stops at the proposal; Apply is deferred to a later resume
decisions.why: User asked for a proposal only and wants to review before implementation

decisions.decision: Do NOT run the DB integration suite while DATABASE_URL points at the live DB and Docker is unavailable; defer test execution to a user-gated step
decisions.why: testdb.Provision applies goose migrations to DATABASE_URL when set; the new migration deletes 2 rows from live vehicle_snapshots. Destructive action requires explicit user go-ahead per CLAUDE.md.

decisions.decision: Batched each wave into ONE serial Sonnet worker instead of parallel workers
decisions.why: Tasks share service.go/telemetry.go and the wave is small; one dispatch reads the doc pack once and avoids concurrent edits to the same files.

decisions.decision: Leader-fixed TestReadStore_LatestSnapshotsByAccount_MultiVehicleLatestWins: vehicle A's two fixtures moved from -2h/-1h to -26h/-1h so they land on different calendar days
decisions.why: Worker reported the same-day fixtures as 'assertions still hold' but T9.2 requires confirming same-day fixtures are intended. They were not: the upsert collapsed them to one row, so DISTINCT ON latest-wins stopped being exercised, and the test's outcome depended on whether it ran just after UTC midnight. >24h apart is date-distinct always.
